design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — in_place_home_sale_approvals task 0 (re-inspection booking payment).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 4]}. Assignment: initial-inspection charge 5 factors (4 parameter, 1 method), vacant-home check charge 6 factors (5 parameter, 1 method), booking payment (root) 4 factors (3 parameter, 1 method). --tasks 2 showed task 1 drawing 1 prerequisite and factor counts [4, 5], so task 1 keeps an independent tree (a price change on the guaranteed program whose prerequisite is an appraisal-fee charge).

[Why a good test] The customer asks for one thing: book the re-inspection and pay for it. The booking policy says a re-inspection is booked against a payment that clears every fee then owed and prepays the visit fee, and it states two prerequisite sentences in state form: 'The booking payment is fixed only after the file's ledger carries the inspection charge owed for every initial inspection recorded on the file.' and 'The booking payment is not worked out until the file's ledger carries the vacant-home check charge owed for every calendar month in which the occupancy recorded on the file has stood vacant.' The agent must read the records (find_resale_records shows the 2025-11-21 initial inspection; find_resale_ledger shows no inspection_fee and no vacant_home_check charge; find_resale_requests shows the 2026-01-09 vacancy report), work out from the inspection-charge and vacant-check policies that their postings bring those states about, compute both (5 and 6 factors over lease, rules, utility and insurance records) and only then compute the booking payment (4 factors plus a ledger reconciliation). Difficulty comes from policy reading, record reconciliation and arithmetic, never from tool choice.

[Scope] Occupied before: nothing (first task). Claimed: resale_ext_initial_inspection_charge -> post_inspection_fee_534473a1 (agent), resale_ext_vacant_home_check_charge -> post_vacant_home_check_55c2c08b (agent), resale_ext_reinspection_booking_payment -> pay_reinspection_booking_26088ed0 (user). Left for task 1: the asking-price change (lowest closing price) and the appraisal charge of the guaranteed program.

[Problem-tree card] root resale_ext_reinspection_booking_payment (on_request, owner=user tool). Edge 1 -> resale_ext_initial_inspection_charge: value_input, gate fees_owed, form state, sentence quoted above (affirmative 'only after'); condition: an inspection_fee charge with source_entry_id = each initial inspection record (none where the fee is 0.00 or the visit-timing method charges nothing). Exactly one write posts inspection_fee charges: post_inspection_fee_534473a1. False at frozen_time: record 0c8dfc66 (initial, 2025-11-21) exists, ledger charges are only service_fee 7668404a, reinspection_fee d75bfdd7, winterization 48aa136a. Edge 2 -> resale_ext_vacant_home_check_charge: value_input, gate fees_owed, form state, sentence quoted above (negated 'not ... until'); exactly one write posts vacant_home_check charges: post_vacant_home_check_55c2c08b. False at frozen_time: occupancy report 05f27235 (accepted 2026-01-09 09:40:00 EST), file home_occupancy vacant, package Owner-Marketed (45.00 a month, not included), no vacant_home_check row. Topological order: inspection charge and vacant check (parallel, commute: 310 + 120 + 85 = 515 either way), then the booking payment. Deletion sensitivity (measured): skip step 12 -> 635.00; skip step 14 -> 670.00; gold 755.00. Owner=user problem: the booking payment, handed over last.

[Base-invariant card] Subject resale_fee_charge (steps 12, 14): governing base policies resale_file_opening_terms (its only gate applies to opening a file), resale_inspection_terms, resale_closing_settlement, resale_withdrawal_terms, resale_vacant_home_terms — no structured gate applies to a charge, all policy_scope. Subject resale_fee_payment (step 16): resale_fee_billing_terms, policy_scope; online_portal_card is an accepted channel. No time gate applies. Overrides declared: resale_inspection_terms 'The initial inspection is charged at the package's inspection_fee on the inspection date; ...' and 'Every re-inspection is charged at reinspection_fee on its date, ...'; resale_vacant_home_terms 'While the file is opened, listed or under contract and the home is vacant, ...'. Restated and inherited: no charge where the fee is 0.00, included checks not charged, included re-inspections credited, oldest-first payment application.

[Business-object card] Target: resale file 5709450f (Owner-Marketed Listing Package, listed). Inspection charge object: initial inspection record 0c8dfc66. Vacant check object: billing period 2026-01. Booking payment: the file's fees owed = all resale_ledger rows of the file (795.00 service fee paid by 1704d068; 125.00 re-inspection d75bfdd7 tied to 85e1a7d1; 185.00 winterization 48aa136a; plus the two new postings). The 2025-12-15 re-inspection is already billed under its own source reference, so it is not the inspection-charge object.

[Factor card — inspection charge] baseline 'The standard inspection charge is the package's inspection_fee ...' = 125.00. home-size (lease 7c3a2742: multi_section, 66 ft >= 64) +55, baseline figure 65.00; home-age (2025 - 2007 = 18 >= 15) +35, 85.00; site-condition (notices under plan record 39397a8d: a3bebc8c of 2025-07-14 counts; near-miss a492373d of 2024-09-10 is 16 whole months old) +15, 105.00; repair-report (5 failing items, tier 3..5) +15, 105.00; visit-timing METHOD (opened 2025-11-10, inspected 2025-11-21 = 11 days: the package fee is waived and the additions alone are charged; the other tiers charge nothing at all, or the fee plus the additions) — standard method gives 245.00. Result 120.00; all-baseline 125.00. Cross-difficulty: lease, rules.
[Factor card — vacant check] baseline 45.00. visit-frequency METHOD (Cedar Hollow, January in winterization_months: weekly checks, subtotal x 2.0; the storm tier adds a flat storm follow-up fee; the fall-through keeps the subtotal) 25.00 under the single-visit method; check-size (66 ft -> +10) 70.00; utility walkthrough (utility 2f717d30 active on the natural gas schedule and winterization charge 48aa136a 0 months old -> +25; near-miss: missing the winterization gives the +20 tier) 47.50; site-crew credit (multi-source over the rules plan and the lease: Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan 39397a8d includes snow removal, the home is at Cedar Hollow, January -> -20; the plan's mowing does not apply in a Cedar Hollow winter month) 105.00; alarm credit (insurance db0127e4 in force, monitored alarm on file -> -15) 100.00; part-month rate (vacancy 2026-01-09, the 9th -> x0.75) 125.00. Result 85.00; all-baseline 45.00. Cross-difficulty: lease, utility, rules, insurance.
[Factor card — booking payment] baseline fees owed + reinspection_fee 75.00 = 590.00. items fee (most recent inspection 2025-12-15 found 3 items -> 95) 725.00; section surcharge (multi_section -> +30, lease) 710.00; repeat surcharge (one re-inspection recorded -> +35) 702.50; repair-window METHOD (43 days > 30: a late re-inspection, sum x 1.5; more than 60 days would replace the items fee with the package inspection_fee as a full inspection) 675.00 under the on-time method. Near-miss: measuring the window from the initial inspection (67 days) lands in the full-inspection tier (125 + 30 + 35 = 190.00 visit fee). Result 755.00.

[World rows] customers 262487c6 (phone 616-555-0163, DOB 1951-03-22); lease 7c3a2742 (rent current, autopay — no lease obligation lit); utility 2f717d30; insurance db0127e4; rules plan 39397a8d and four rules records (two notices with cure confirmations); resale file 5709450f; two inspection records; four ledger rows; two requests. Automatic clauses: listing term to 2026-02-22; winterization charged this winter; January check owed is exactly the prerequisite; no closing, withdrawal or extension falls due. The 2025-12-15 re-inspection charge of 125.00 follows the extended visit-fee rule (items 95 + section 30, first visit, on time).

[Persona] Maureen Pulaski, 74; volunteers only the goal; gives DOB, then SSN last four or email if asked; says she is at her daughter's since January 9th only if asked; agrees when told postings are needed or that the amount covers what is owed; pays by debit card through the portal when handed the action; ends on confirmation.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> find_resale_listings -> find_resale_records -> find_resale_ledger -> find_resale_requests -> find_lease_holdings -> find_utility_accounts -> find_insurance_policies -> find_rules_site_plans -> find_rules_records -> unlock + call post_inspection_fee_534473a1(5709450f, 0c8dfc66, 2025-11-21, 120.00) -> unlock + call post_vacant_home_check_55c2c08b(5709450f, 2026-01, 2026-01-09, 85.00) -> unlock_user + customer calls pay_reinspection_booking_26088ed0(5709450f, 755.00, online_portal_card).

[Verification run] Recomputation with check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on the replayed handling-time worlds: inspection charge result 120.0 baseline 125.0, factors 65/85/105/105/245; vacant check result 85.0 baseline 45.0, factors 25/70/47.5/105/100/125; booking payment result 755.0 baseline 590.0, factors 725/710/702.5/675; fees_owed 515.0, visit_fee 240.0. Final gates: EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY, SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE all OK.

[Revisions] Round 1: (1) history not load-bearing for the inspection and check charges -> repair-report addition (MAX) and winterized-home tier (COUNT) added -> COMPUTE OK. (2) date_of_birth not verbatim in persona -> '1951-03-22' added.
Round 2 (policy-task audit): F1/T0-1 symptom: four 'method' factors were plain multipliers (visit timing, visit frequency, part month, repair window). Root cause: tiers only changed a constant in one formula. Change: visit timing became a genuine method (nothing / additions alone with the package fee waived / fee plus additions) — inspection charge 122.50 -> 120.00; visit frequency became a genuine method (subtotal x weekly rate / subtotal plus a flat storm follow-up fee / subtotal itself) — 85.00 unchanged; part month relabelled parameter (it selects a rate value); repair window became a genuine method (lapsed: package inspection_fee replaces the items fee / late: sum x 1.5 / on time: sum) — 240.00 unchanged; booking payment 757.50 -> 755.00 (fees owed 517.50 -> 515.00). Re-run: COMPUTE OK with the figures above. T0-2: objectives of steps 12, 14, 16 and the step-8 necessity rewritten to the recomputed figures and to the charter's actual factors. O-a: the booking near-miss is now the window anchor (initial inspection, 67 days) instead of the same-tier item count. O-c/O11: the site-crew credit now conditions on the rules plan and the lease community (two records) on every non-fall-through tier. O1: the vacant-check rule states the month charged is the month in progress on the day the charge is worked out. O2: the site-condition count is scoped to the site's plan record. O3: the booking baseline sentence carries the included re-inspection exception.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules as published, the tool schemas, the persona and the finder returns: booking needs fees owed cleared; the ledger lacks the inspection charge and January's check; the inspection-charge rule (late visit: fee waived, additions 55 + 35 + 15 + 15) gives 120.00 and the vacant-check rule gives 85.00; fees owed 310 + 120 + 85 = 515.00; visit fee (95 + 30 + 35) x 1.5 = 240.00; payment 755.00 by online_portal_card — identical to gold, one reading.
user_scenario: You are Maureen T. Pulaski, 74, a retired school secretary whose manufactured home sits on site D-417 at Cedar Hollow, outside Grand Rapids. You are selling it yourself through Hearthstone's resale office and you are calling from your cell, 616-555-0163. You speak politely, a little slowly, and you like to get things settled in one call. You open by saying who you are and what you want: the inspector's December visit still listed three things to fix, your nephew finished all three last weekend (new address numbers, the loose downspout and the skirting vent), and you would like to book the re-inspection and pay for it today, while you have someone on the phone. You do not know your resale file number and say so if asked; the desk can look you up. When the agent asks you to confirm your identity you give your date of birth, March 22, 1951 (1951-03-22); if a further detail is wanted you give the last four of your Social Security number, 4417, or your email, maureen.pulaski@gmail.com. Only if the agent asks whether anyone is living in the home do you say that you have been staying at your daughter's in Grand Rapids since January 9th and that you phoned the office that morning to report the home empty. You leave the office side of things to the agent: if the agent tells you something has to be put on your file or taken care of on their end before the booking can go through, you tell them to go ahead and do it. If the agent tells you the booking payment is more than the re-inspection itself because it also covers what is owed on your file, you accept that; you just want the inspection booked and nothing left hanging. You want to pay with your debit card through the resident portal; you have no checkbook with you and you will not go to the office. When the agent hands the payment over to you, you make it on your own file for exactly the amount the agent tells you, by debit card through the portal, and if the agent asks you read back the confirmation number the portal gives you. If the agent never mentions any other item, you do not raise one. You do not know how fees are worked out and never suggest a figure. Once the agent confirms the payment went through and the re-inspection is booked, you thank them warmly and say goodbye.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile from the phone number she gives, returning her customer reference number and the profile details to verify against.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to this customer; without the profile no account can be opened.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record an in-session identity verification with two details the caller states (phone number and date of birth) matched against the profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The desk may not discuss the resale file or take a payment until identity is verified; two matching details are the verification threshold.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the seller's resale file: package (Owner-Marketed Listing Package), status listed, opening date 2025-11-10, recorded occupancy vacant, lease reference and fees owed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The package fixes the inspection fee, re-inspection fee, vacant-home check fee and winterization months; the opening date drives the visit-timing rate; the file number keys every write.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the file's inspections: the initial inspection of 2025-11-21 (repairs required, 5 items) and the re-inspection of 2025-12-15 (repairs required, 3 items).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The initial inspection is the record the missing inspection charge bills (prerequisite of the booking payment); its date sets the home-age year and visit-timing rate; the 2025-12-15 re-inspection sets the items fee, the repeat-visit surcharge and the repair-window rate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every charge and payment on the file: service fee 795.00 paid 2025-11-18, re-inspection fee 125.00, winterization 185.00, and the absence of any inspection-fee charge and of any January vacant-home check charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the inspection charge owed for the initial inspection and the January vacant-home check are not on the ledger (the two states the booking payment's prerequisite sentences wait on) and gives the fees owed that the booking payment clears.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the seller's accepted occupancy report dated 2026-01-09 that records the home vacant.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Dates the vacancy: the January check is owed from that day, dated on it, and the part-month rate is decided by the day of the month it falls on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the seller's site lease: Cedar Hollow site D-417, a multi-section 2007 home 66 feet long.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Community and home attributes decide the inspection home-size and home-age additions, the check visit-frequency rate and check-size addition, and the booking section surcharge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the site's utility account: active on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the utility walkthrough addition of the vacant-home check.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the seller's Hearthstone home insurance policy: in force, one paid claim, monitored alarm on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the alarm credit of the vacant-home check (monitored alarm on file with the in-force Hearthstone policy).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the site-care plan record: Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan, enrolled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the site-crew credit of the vacant-home check (a plan with snow removal in a winterization month).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the rule violation notices on the site: one served 2025-07-14 and one served 2024-09-10, with their cure outcomes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the site-condition addition of the inspection charge: only the 2025-07-14 notice is fewer than twelve whole months old.
